description: Lund University-procured ChatGPT Edu in a University-managed academic workspace.
howToObtain: Apply for a ChatGPT licence through Lucat; after approval, join the workspace from the welcome email and authenticate via University SSO.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: ChatGPT Edu is free through 2026 for Lund University teachers and researchers after a Lucat license application. Lund says ChatGPT is purchased and approved for work when signed in through Lucat; students are not eligible, while doctoral students and specially approved administrative staff have stated paths.

description: Lund University's purchased Microsoft Copilot web service for employees.
howToObtain: Go to m365.cloud.microsoft and sign in with Lucat ID followed by @lu.se.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Lund University says it purchased Microsoft's Copilot. All LU employees who sign in using their Lucat Microsoft 365 account have Copilot Web.

description: Lund University's licensed AI translation service with LU-specific terminology support.
howToObtain: Assigned staff receive login instructions from Translation and Language Services.
costToUser: No cost stated for assigned staff.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Lund University purchased 200 DeepL licenses to distribute to staff across faculties and departments for one year. Assigned users receive login instructions from Translation and Language Services.

description: Lund University's M365-integrated Copilot for eligible departments.
howToObtain: Apply via Lucat using the University's software-licence process.
costToUser: Free to individual departments during the central 2026 licence offer.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: M365 Copilot requires a Lucat application following the University's software-license process. Lund University centrally purchased M365 Copilot licenses that are free of charge for individual departments during 2026.
